committed_after_reads.rationale: 查詢檔指定 S. cerevisiae S288C（taxid 559292）與 maltose。先從固定版本的封存庫取回具名天然蛋白、反應註釋和測定原始條目，才能判定哪些條件可歸到個別蛋白。這項查詢只需一次本機讀取，並產生可供下一種二糖比對的原件。
查詢檔已指定 S288C（taxid 559292）和麥芽糖，既有查詢正對應這份材料。等待交付 parent-records.json，再依反應識別碼、方向、實測底物及蛋白歸屬決定刊登文字。同一原始測定經不同介面出現時只計一次。重跑相同查詢不會增加獨立證據，本輪保留原件供後續二糖比對。

已逐筆核對查詢原件及 parent-records.json。MAL12 與 MAL32 各有 ENZYME 分類來源行，兩筆的 reaction_links 都是空陣列。MAL12 所連的 BRENDA 條目分別記載其他具名底物與未指明底物，MAL32 沒有連結測定，SABIO-RK 也沒有連結條目。這些記錄足以決定本版品管頁的刊登範圍。重跑相同快照只會再次讀取同一批原始記錄。可重用程序已儲存並在目錄核對。

committed_after_reads.rationale: The IMGT map identifies both chains and fixes each CDR denominator independently of the coordinates. The single-chain method recorded an execution failure. The paired reader can check deposition and polymer identity and localize coverage in one local job. Its output should distinguish numbering gaps from unobserved assigned sites and establish which coordinate comparisons the archive supports.

The supplied IMGT map assigns 8, 10 and 9 residues to VH CDR1–3 and 11, 3 and 9 to VL CDR1–3. The commissioned paired reader checks those assignments against the deposited polymers and coordinates. Its job has succeeded according to the catalogue, and the result is awaiting delivery. Reading its six loop masks and atom rule will resolve the curator’s question without a duplicate job and provide a tested node for the reusable workflow.

The paired reader accepted the map for 4FAB assembly 1 and recovered the annotated heavy chain B (entity 2) and κ light chain A (entity 1). The map assigns 8, 10 and 9 positions to VH CDR1–3 and 11, 3 and 9 to VL CDR1–3. In fab_coverage.json each loop's matched count equals its assigned count, giving {{metric:matched_positions}} positive-occupancy model-1 Cα sites across {{metric:mapped_positions}} assignments. This supports Cα trace comparisons at shared IMGT positions. Repeating this measurement would add no evidence about the other backbone atoms. The tested workflow is available as paired-fab-imgt-ca-coverage@1.

Figure 4 in the supplied paper directly addresses the proposed ranking. Across 134 eligible countries, the reported Spearman correlations with GDP growth were 0.17 for change in summed radiance and 0.24 for change in lit area. The strong level correlations and similar sample medians answer different questions. The independent reading in progress will check the coefficient assignments and sample before publication of the conclusion. The question is about this paper, so another data acquisition would not improve this comparison.

Figure 4 directly tests the proposed ordering across 134 eligible countries. For changes from 2012 to 2016, the reported Spearman correlation with real GDP growth was 0.17 for the change in nationally summed radiance (P = 0.05) and 0.24 for the change in lit area (P = 0.006). Both indicate weak agreement between country rankings. The director can compare changes in detected lighting and can report that GDP and light levels were strongly associated across countries, with correlations of 0.85 for national totals and 0.76 per capita (both P ≪ 0.001). The median increases of 15% in radiance and 13% in GDP summarize the distributions separately. Independent review of the partial module’s two extractions against the Results, Figure 4 caption and Methods confirmed these assignments and resolved the outstanding interpretation. All are observations from one paper.
